## Definition of done (PRD §12.3)
- [ ] code + tests + types, docstring on public API
- [ ] config and docs updated; ADR added if a decision changed
- [ ] no new warnings; `nox -s lint types tests` green
- [ ] `contracts/` or `certify/` touched → reviewed by a second CODEOWNER
- [ ] ≤ ~400 changed lines (split otherwise)
